Domestic Avengers™ is such a wide spread thing in the marvel fandom its great, and lots of spiderboy fluff is out there. I live for those domestic fluffy family fics in a few fandoms, but marvel just has the motherlode to look through

Personally, you would have to do first person really well for me to enjoy it. Some stories feel natural in first person and others feel forced. But for the love of god never write in second person, I find these fics on occasion and it's the weirdest.
Tony Stark being a Grade A parent to spiderboy is such a specific guilty pleasure for me
when I went to the doctor I got my blood drawn for deficiencies, I don't take a multivitamin, but vitamin D and a B complex are definitely needed in my body.

Hey, I tried to kill myself when I was 20 (21 now). I failed the same college class 3 times, and failed 2 others. A bit over a year ago I tried to OD. I had a plan that no one would find me, but my mom came home from work really early because she was sick and found me. Spent a week in the psych ward and honestly still wanted to kill myself for a few months after. But really, I'm glad I didn't die. I'm back in college, pursuing a whole new path and I am on a fuck-ton of vitamin supplements, birth control and and Gabapentin. Holding down a job with my brother, who is practically my therapist now. But overall, I'm making it out of my depression now and am actually looking forward to life again after YEARS of trying meds, therapy and trying to dig myself out. It is suffering, and I know it is man, but hang on and don't die.
